look.why: A soft nectar-blossom pink that echoes the trumpet flowers it hovers beside and highlights its ruby throat.

habitat.text: Woodland edges, meadows, orchards and flower gardens across eastern North America, wintering in Central America.

diet.text: Flower nectar (eating up to twice its body weight daily) plus tiny spiders, gnats and aphids.

facts.text: It beats its wings 53 times per second and is the only bird family able to hover motionless and fly backwards or upside down!
Despite weighing less than a nickel (3 grams), many migrate non-stop 800 km across the open Gulf of Mexico.

id.habitat: Tepi hutan, padang bunga, kebun buah, dan taman di Amerika Utara bagian timur, bermigrasi ke Amerika Tengah saat musim dingin.
id.diet: Nektar bunga (memakan hingga dua kali bobot tubuhnya per hari) ditambah laba-laba kecil dan serangga mungil.
facts: Ia mengepakkan sayap 53 kali per detik dan menjadi satu-satunya keluarga burung yang mampu melayang diam serta terbang mundur!
Meski beratnya hanya sekitar 3 gram, banyak di antaranya bermigrasi nonstop sejauh 800 km melintasi Teluk Meksiko.
